boards.title: Your First Weekend at University of California-Merced, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A low-key, under-21-safe sequence for learning the UC Merced campus, using recreation resources, and ending with a downtown art stop.

cards.title: Start with the self-guided campus walk
cards.subtitle: Daytime orientation · UC Merced campus
cards.notes: Open the official tour map, choose a few stops, and walk at your own pace to connect campus names with the buildings you will use.
cards.short_summary: A flexible first pass through key campus landmarks.
cards.evidence_claim: UC Merced publishes a self-guided tour with stops including housing, recreation, dining, the library, Academic Quad, South Bowl and solar panels.
cards.access_notes: Follow posted campus access and safety guidance; the source describes this as a self-guided tour.

cards.title: Meet at the Beginnings sculpture
cards.subtitle: Carol Tomlinson-Keasey Quad · UC Merced
cards.notes: Use the 40-foot stainless-steel sculpture as an easy visual meeting point, then take a moment to see the quad from its open end.
cards.short_summary: A named campus artwork tied to UC Merced’s student journey.
cards.evidence_claim: UC Merced identifies Beginnings as a 40-foot stainless-steel sculpture and says students process through it during Scholars Bridge Crossing.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor campus artwork; observe any posted access guidance.

cards.title: Walk through Academic Quad
cards.subtitle: Campus academic core · UC Merced
cards.notes: Make this a short daylight loop between the laboratory buildings, using the walk to learn where your early-quarter classes and services sit.
cards.short_summary: A campus quad anchored by wet and dry laboratory buildings.
cards.evidence_claim: UC Merced states that three new wet and dry laboratories anchor the Academic Quad and connect to the existing campus by a bridge.
cards.access_notes: Exterior walk; building entry may vary by posted access rules.

cards.title: Get your bearings in Kolligian Library
cards.subtitle: Library stop · UC Merced
cards.notes: Locate the library’s floor maps and campus-map links, then use the building as a reference point while you learn the surrounding paths.
cards.short_summary: A central library stop with official building and campus map resources.
cards.evidence_claim: The UC Merced Library provides Kolligian Library floor maps and links to campus maps with building, street and parking details.
cards.access_notes: Check the library’s current access information before entering.

cards.title: Pause at the Lantern Café
cards.subtitle: Inside Kolligian Library · UC Merced
cards.notes: If you want a daytime refreshment break, confirm service before heading over and pair it with a quick look at the library’s public spaces.
cards.short_summary: A campus café located in the library.
cards.evidence_claim: UC Merced Dining Services identifies the Lantern Café as operating in the Leo and Dottie Kolligian Library.
cards.access_notes: Food and beverages require purchase; verify current café service before visiting.

cards.title: Share a meal at Yablokoff-Wallace
cards.subtitle: On-campus dining · UC Merced
cards.notes: Choose a meal window that works for your group, check current service first, and use the outdoor seating for an unhurried campus catch-up.
cards.short_summary: UC Merced’s on-campus resident dining center.
cards.evidence_claim: UC Merced says on-campus residents can eat at the Yablokoff-Wallace Dining Center and describes breakfast, entrees, produce, salad-bar and to-go options.
cards.access_notes: Meals require purchase or an applicable meal plan; verify current dining service before visiting.

cards.entity_name: Joseph Edward Gallo Recreation and Wellness Center
cards.title: Add a recreation-center session
cards.subtitle: Campus recreation · UC Merced
cards.notes: Check facility eligibility and hours, then choose a comfortable activity such as cardio, a group exercise class, or a casual workout with a friend.
cards.short_summary: The campus recreation center offers fitness and group-exercise equipment.
cards.evidence_claim: UC Merced Admissions says the recreation center has cardio, fitness and group-exercise equipment, and its hours page lists weekend building hours.
cards.source_title: Campus Life | UC Merced Undergraduate Admissions
cards.access_notes: Confirm current eligibility, facility hours and any reservation requirements with Recreation & Athletics.

cards.title: Explore the Student Activities and Athletics Center
cards.subtitle: SAAC · UC Merced
cards.notes: Stop by to identify the meeting and activity spaces, then note the Wilderness Desk if you want a later outdoor outing or planning advice.
cards.short_summary: A campus activity hub with club spaces and the Wilderness Desk.
cards.evidence_claim: UC Merced says the Student Activities and Athletics Center has meeting rooms, a spinning room, dance room and weight room, plus the Yosemite Leadership Program Wilderness Desk.
cards.source_title: Student Activities and Athletics Center | UC Merced Recreation & Athletics
cards.access_notes: The official building-hours page lists Saturday 10 a.m.–10 p.m. and Sunday noon–1 a.m.; confirm access before going.

cards.title: Plan an outing at the Outdoor Center
cards.subtitle: Inside SAAC · UC Merced
cards.notes: Ask staff about the trip calendar, beginner-appropriate options, equipment rentals, or bicycle repair sessions before committing to a future adventure.
cards.short_summary: The campus base for Outdoor Experience Program information and gear.
cards.evidence_claim: UC Merced identifies the Outdoor Center in SAAC as the home of the Outdoor Experience Program, with staff, equipment rentals and a small library.
cards.source_title: Outdoor Experience Program | UC Merced Recreation & Athletics
cards.access_notes: Check current Outdoor Center availability; rentals and some trips may carry fees.

cards.title: Finish downtown at the MAC galleries
cards.subtitle: 645 W. Main Street · Merced
cards.notes: Check the current exhibition and gallery schedule, then leave enough time to look through the galleries and talk about what you noticed.
cards.short_summary: A downtown arts center with multiple galleries and public exhibitions.
cards.evidence_claim: The Merced County Arts Council says the Multicultural Arts Center has four art galleries and the Arbor Gallery, and lists its Merced address and gallery hours.
cards.source_title: The MAC | Merced County Arts Council
cards.access_notes: The official site lists gallery hours Wednesday–Friday 2–8 p.m., Saturday 11 a.m.–6 p.m., and Sunday 11 a.m.–4 p.m.; confirm before travel.
